caseName: Corn Products Refining Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Corn Products Refining Co. v. United States
attorneys: Ernest S. Ballard and Parker McCollester for appellant. Acting Solicitor General Washington and Daniel W. Knowlton for the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission, appel-lees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. United States v. American Sheet & Tin Plate Co., 301 U. S. 402; United States v. Wabash R. Co., 321 U. S. 403.
